plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Political Science, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 2106R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/social-science-and-communication-department/political-science/political-science-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published minimum ('Total Credit Hours: 60-61'); semester tables print 15/15-16/15/14-15. Modeled honestly per corpus convention (minimum-credit path + notes): 'SCIG GE2 3-4 Credits' in Spring Freshman at 3; 'ELEC ANY College Level Elective Courses 9-10 Credits' in Spring Sophomore at 10 - the 10-credit value is required for the plan to reach the catalog's published 60-credit minimum (the pure minimum-credit combination sums to 59). Semester totals 15/15/15/15. Choice slots: ELEC ANY (college-level electives, student choice; catalog caps electives at 20 credits from one discipline area); COMM GE / MATH GE / SOCS GE / HUMA GE / HUMA GE2 / SCIG GE2 / WELL GE are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Footnotes: Social Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Humanities courses must be from 2 different disciplines; Science courses must be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.' Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
